_comment: Moderation's defaults, shipped as a library layer (composition D3, grill Q6). An application's
App_Data/moderation.json composes on top per key: a privilege or reputation event by name,
"Review": null removes a privilege, and arrays are replaced whole. The composed result is the
lowest-precedence IConfiguration source under Spark:Moderation, so appsettings and environment
Each privilege confers a SLOT, never a group id. The application binds it in security.json:
An unbound slot refuses startup. Grants lists the rights --spark-init-moderation prints.
